ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of Medicaid fraud schemes in Minnesota
questions: How are Medicaid fraud schemes financed?
What are the most common methods of payment?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial trails of Medicaid fraud schemes, we can identify patterns and connections between entities and individuals. This can help us track the flow of money and prevent future fraudulent activity.
